description: Ledger of roster and gathering moves since the prior weekly cut. Use this for 'what changed', rank moves, names that entered or left a top 5. Optional since (YYYY-MM-DD), market, and layer. layer=beyond is Attic Beyond. An empty list means the rosters did not move.

layer.description: headlines is public. beyond is Attic Beyond.

market.description: Market: rare-coins, sports-cards, collector-cars, or art. Names such as Rare Coins or fine art are accepted.

since.description: Optional prior date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the retained previous cut.

name: attic_get_changes
title: What changed this week
